# How to Produce

<!-- STEP id="factors" -->
After deciding what to produce, a producer must decide **how to produce** it. Every producer mixes four **factors of production**: land, labour, capital and technology. Production can be **labour-intensive**, with more workers and fewer machines, or **capital-intensive**, with more machines and fewer workers.

<!-- STEP id="examples" -->
Farming and handicrafts usually depend more on workers. Industries such as steel and car making depend more on machines.

**How to produce means choosing the mix of workers and machines.**
